title: Orientation
description: auto follows the page's shape: a wide page draws time left→right, a tall page draws time running upward (the mania side strip).

title: Alignment
description: Mirrors the layout. Vertical: the side the graph's baseline and time labels sit on (put it towards the stage). Horizontal: the side of the label and the clock.

title: Skills
description: combined = one silhouette of the summed skill strains. per-skill = the same silhouette split into stacked bands: osu! aim and speed, taiko colour, rhythm and stamina. Catch (movement) and mania (strains) have a single skill.

title: Show time
description: Time axis labels and the elapsed / total clock.

title: Show kiai and breaks
description: Marks kiai (accent strip) and break (hatched) sections. vosu reports them as the map clock passes them, in play and in the song-select preview; each map remembers the sections already seen.

title: Show in song select
description: Full-map strain preview following the preview clock (osu! shows no strain graph). The page stays where it is placed, so turn this off if that spot covers song-select content. Results and other screens show nothing.

title: Backing
description: none: marks and text float on the game. scrim: a soft dark fade behind the page for bright backgrounds. panel: a graphite panel.

title: Accent
description: map: tint the graph with the beatmap background's colour (M3 tonal spot). 18-lab: always the amber accent.
